none: PAS NLM-C080F4: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTI[---]VG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLO[RIA EXERCITVS]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.5mm, Weight: 1.88gms, die axis: probably 12
